title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Grimsby) Regulations 2026
The Sentencing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 4) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Sentencing Act 2026 (“the 2026 Act”) (c. 2).

title: Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations designate a number of television selection services as regulated television selection services for the purposes of Part 3A of the Communications Act 2023 (c. 21) (prominence on television selection services).

title: The Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the second commencement Regulations made under the Terrorism (Protection of Premises) Act 2025 (c. 10) (“the Act”).

title: The Branded Health Service Medicines (Costs) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Branded Health Service Medicines (Costs) Regulations 2018 (S.I. 2018/345) (the “Statutory Scheme Regulations”). The Statutory Scheme Regulations, amongst other matters, make a scheme for the purpose of requiring specific manufacturers and suppliers of branded medicines for health service use to pay certain amounts to the Secretary of State. These amounts are calculated by reference to the net sales income or estimated net sales income from supplies of such medicines. These amendments update the payment percentages for 2026 and subsequent years.

title: The Public Service Pensions Act 2013 (Amendment of Section 3) Order 2026
summary: Section 3(6) of the Public Service Pensions Act 2013 (c. 25) (“the 2013 Act”) lists certain types of scheme regulations that are exempt from the requirement in section 3(5) of the Public Service Pensions Act 2013 to obtain consent from HM Treasury before being made.

title: The Income Tax (Pay As You Earn) (Amendment No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Income Tax (Pay As You Earn) Regulations 2003 (the “PAYE Regulations”), which make provision for the assessment, charge, collection and recovery of income tax in respect of all pay as you earn (“PAYE”) income.

title: The Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017 (S.I. 2017/692) (the “MLRs”).

title: The Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 (Temporary Class Drug) Order 2026
summary: Article 2 of this Order specifies the substances and products listed in the Schedule as drugs subject to temporary control under section 2A(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971. The substances and products listed in the Schedule are types of synthetic opioids which are being misused as new psychoactive substances. Paragraphs 2 to 4 specify derivatives of the substances specified in paragraph 1 of the Schedule.

title: The Controlled Drugs (Drug Precursors) (Amendment and Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the powers in sections 14(2), (3), (4)(a), (b), (c) and (e) and (7) and 20(1)(a) of the Retained EU Law (Revocation and Reform) Act 2023 (c. 28) (“the 2023 Act”). These Regulations revoke, replace and make alternative provision in secondary assimilated law which establish the processes and rules governing the control and trade in drug precursor chemicals in Great Britain, and trade between Great Britain, Northern Ireland and third countries.

title: The Whole of Government Accounts (Designation of Bodies) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: This Order designates bodies, for the financial year ending with 31st March 2026, for the purposes of section 15 of the Government Resources and Accounts Act (Northern Ireland) 2001. The Department of Finance (“the Department”) intends to pass the information provided by bodies so designated in the Schedule to this Order to the Treasury for use in the preparation of the Whole of Government Accounts (WGA). The designation enables the Department to require those bodies to provide financial information in relation to the year in question. The bodies designated include the District Councils for the 11 Local Government Districts established pursuant to the Local Government (Boundaries) Act (Northern Ireland) 2008.

title: The Police and Criminal Evidence (Northern Ireland) Order 1989 (Codes of Practice) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints 1st July 2026 as the date on which revised codes of practice under Articles 60, 60A and 65 of the Police and Criminal Evidence (Northern Ireland) Order 1989 will come into operation. The revised codes will supersede the corresponding existing codes of practice.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Cramlington, Newcastle) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Dangerous Dogs (Exemption Schemes) (England and Wales) (Amendment) Order 2026
The Customs (Safety and Security Procedures) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to safety and security provisions in existing customs legislation.

title: The Customs (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make various amendments to existing customs Regulations.

title: The Police (Conduct) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Police (Conduct) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/4) (“the Conduct Regulations”).

title: The Morecambe Offshore Windfarm Generation Assets (Correction) Order 2026
The Cory Decarbonisation Project (Correction) Order 2026
summary: This Order corrects errors in the Cory Decarbonisation Project Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/1227), a development consent order made under the Planning Act 2008, following a request made under paragraph 1(5)(a) of Schedule 4 to that Act.

title: The Education (School Development Plans) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations, which are made under Article 13(3) of the Education (Northern Ireland) Order 1998, relate to school development plans in grant-aided schools.
